chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who marries off a bachelor is among those whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will look upon (with mercy) on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for helping a bachelor get married?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the social and spiritual merit of facilitating marriage, framing it as an act of divine favor where Allah 'looks upon' the facilitator with mercy on the Day of Judgment. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that marriage is not merely a personal contract but a communal duty (Sunnah) that strengthens the Ummah, with the promise of divine attention serving as a powerful incentive for those who remove barriers for the unmarried.
